issues.jp_before: 牛乳[ぎゅうにゅう]がなくなったから、買[か]いに{行[い]かなければならない|pt-nakereba}。
issues.problem: Plain-form obligation slot lacked the equally natural なくてはいけない alternative.
issues.action: Added 行[い]かなくてはいけない as alternative.

issues.jp_before: 犬[いぬ]を飼[か]うなら、毎日[まいにち]えさを{やらなければならない|pt-nakereba}。
issues.problem: Missing equally natural なくてはいけない alternative.
issues.action: Added やらなくてはいけない as alternative.

issues.jp_before: 来週[らいしゅう]のテストのために、漢字[かんじ]を{覚[おぼ]えなければならない|pt-nakereba}。
issues.problem: Missing equally natural なくてはいけない alternative.
issues.action: Added 覚[おぼ]えなくてはいけない as alternative.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]に今晩[こんばん]、電話[でんわ]を{かけないと|pt-nakereba}。
issues.problem: Unnatural word order (time word after the indirect object with a stray comma).
issues.action: Reordered to 今晩[こんばん]、母[はは]に電話[でんわ]を{かけないと|pt-nakereba}。

issues.jp_before: 乗[の]り換[か]えがあるので、次[つぎ]の駅[えき]で{降[お]りなくてはいけません/降[お]りなければなりません|pt-nakereba}。
issues.problem: English repeated 'I have to' twice and misrendered 乗り換えがある.
issues.action: English changed to 'I need to change trains, so I have to get off at the next station.'

issues.jp_before: 熱[ねつ]があるから、今日[きょう]は早[はや]く{帰[かえ]らないと|pt-nakereba}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 早く/そろそろ帰らないと item (same answer verb and frame).
issues.action: Replaced with 熱[ねつ]があるから、今日[きょう]は早[はや]く{寝[ね]ないと|pt-nakereba}。 ('I have to go to bed early today'), new distractors and why.

issues.jp_before: よかったら、今晩[こんばん]うちで晩[ばん]ご飯[はん]を{食[た]べませんか|pt-mashou}。
issues.problem: English 'If you like, would you like to...' was redundant and unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'If you're free, would you like to have dinner at my place tonight?'

issues.jp_before: みんなで、ゲームを{しましょう|pt-mashou}。
issues.problem: みんなで means 'all together', not a vocative 'everyone'; stray comma.
issues.action: Removed comma; English changed to 'Let's all play a game together.'

issues.jp_before: お腹[なか]がすきましたね。じゃあ、何[なに]か{作[つく]りましょう|pt-mashou}。
issues.problem: English split the line into two speakers ('I'm hungry' / 'Then...'), but the Japanese is one speaker's ね-remark plus proposal.
issues.action: English changed to 'We're hungry, aren't we? Well then, let's make something.'

issues.jp_before: 重[おも]そうですね。{手伝[てつだ]いましょうか|pt-mashou}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 重そうですね。荷物を持ちましょうか item (same context).
issues.action: Rewrote as 忙[いそが]しそうですね。{手伝[てつだ]いましょうか|pt-mashou}。 'You look busy. Shall I help you?'
